offering_description.value: Jacobs provides engineering, design, consulting and infrastructure services to businesses and public agencies. It advises clients, designs and delivers projects, and supports ongoing operations. It also supplies software for infrastructure planning and facility operations.

quotes.quote: Jacobs is a global professional services company delivering science-based, digitally enabled, end-to-end solutions — from consulting and advisory to design and implementation — across the world’s most complex infrastructure, advanced manufacturing, environmental and technology challenges.
